title: Qt: Support for slide testing and startup performance improvement
description:
Introduce a banner slides test mode, which shows all slides of
the chosen categories. It also gives full control which slide is
to be shown, without automatic advance.

Repeated preference setting causes the slide deck to be recreated
over and over again, especially during startup. Reduce the calls to
applySlideFilter to the bare functional minimum.

AI-Assisted: no

+Slide Testing
+-------------
+
+To assist in developing slides, by showing all eligable slides, the
+banner carousel has a 'hidden' test setting. This setting can be found
+in the "recent_common" file under the name:
+"gui.welcome_page.sidebar.tips_slides_test"
+
+When changing its value to 'true' and starting Wireshark afterwards,
+the banner carousel will be loaded with all eligable slides, according
+to the selected slide types. The dots can now be used to select among
+them. Auto advance is disabled in this case, so the selected slide will
+remain until another is chosen. This allows for careful evaluation of
+the slide designs.
